title: Brazil
attribution: World Climate Simulation materials by Climate Interactive, MIT Sloan, and the UMass Lowell Climate Change Initiative. Updated November 2025. Adapted for nested-agent experiments.
goals: Deliver a credible outcome as host of COP30 in Belém
End illegal deforestation in the Amazon by 2030 while supporting rural livelihoods
Secure international finance for standing forests and a just energy transition
negotiating_constraints: Developed nations must lead on emissions cuts and finance
Oil and gas expansion and agribusiness are major economic interests
Forest finance must respect national sovereignty over the Amazon
opportunities: Large-scale forest restoration and avoided deforestation
climate_risks: Floods and heat affecting cities and agriculture
adaptation_notes: No World Climate briefing exists for Brazil. Its members read the Other Developing Nations briefing, which covers Central and South America. The goals, constraints, opportunities and risks below are author-written summaries of public positions up to November 2025. Goals and qualitative constraints paraphrase the briefing. Baseline commitments, numeric ceilings, finance-role restrictions, personalities and scoring are author-created experimental assumptions, NOT official prescribed positions. Source text reflects November 2025 and is not a live policy fact-check.
